import json,hashlib,zlib,base64
from ghidra.program.model.address import AddressSet
from ghidra.program.model.pcode import JumpTable
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
from ghidra.program.flatapi import FlatProgramAPI
from java.util import ArrayList
p=currentProgram
fm=p.getFunctionManager()
api=FlatProgramAPI(p,monitor)
af=p.getAddressFactory()
def a(x): return af.getAddress(x.removeprefix("0x"))
rows=[{'start': '0x1409ac910', 'end': '0x1409ae3cf', 'jump': '0x1409ad07b', 'targets': ['0x1409ad64f', '0x1409ad07d', '0x1409ad1a3', '0x1409ad467'], 'sha256': 'baaa2fd49bbfd5afcc11742530dca68e5642e6cfc1612ba5a138f53fbbf56f17'}]
result=[]
for row in rows:
 monitor.checkCancelled()
 start,end=a(row["start"]),a(row["end"])
 raw=bytes(x&255 for x in api.getBytes(start,int(end.subtract(start))))
 if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=row["sha256"]: raise RuntimeError("Original code SHA mismatch")
 f=fm.getFunctionAt(start)
 tx=p.startTransaction("M01 circle bounded original flow")
 try:
  body=AddressSet(start,end.subtract(1))
  for other in fm.getFunctionsOverlapping(body):
   if other.getEntryPoint()!=start: body.delete(other.getBody())
  f.setBody(body)
  cases=ArrayList()
  for target in row["targets"]: cases.add(a(target))
  JumpTable(a(row["jump"]),cases,True,0).writeOverride(f)
  p.endTransaction(tx,True)
 except:
  p.endTransaction(tx,False)
  raise
 di=DecompInterface()
 try:
  di.openProgram(p)
  d=di.decompileFunction(f,45,monitor)
  result.append(dict(address=row["start"],body_bytes=f.getBody().getNumAddresses(),completed=d.decompileCompleted(),error=str(d.getErrorMessage()),gz=base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(d.getDecompiledFunction().getC().encode())).decode() if d.decompileCompleted() else None))
 finally: di.dispose()
print(json.dumps(dict(sha256=p.getExecutableSHA256(),result=result)))
